mapper.select: SELECT e.document_id,e.document_version,e.model,e.dimensions,e.chunked_at,e.child_count,e.batch_count, e.call_count,e.total_tokens,e.duration_ms,e.updated_at AS embedded_at FROM document_embedding_result e JOIN document_chunk_result c ON c.document_id=e.document_id AND c.document_version=e.document_version AND c.updated_at=e.chunked_at JOIN document_parse_result p ON p.document_id=c.document_id AND p.document_version=c.document_version AND p.updated_at <= c.updated_at WHERE e.document_id=#{id} AND e.document_version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_embedding_result(document_id,document_version,model,dimensions,chunked_at, child_count,batch_count,call_count,total_tokens,duration_ms) VALUES (#{documentId},#{documentVersion},#{model},#{dimensions},#{chunkedAt},#{childCount},#{batchCount},#{callCount},#{totalTokens},#{durationMs}) ON CONFLICT(document_id,document_version) DO UPDATE SET model=excluded.model, dimensions=excluded.dimensions, chunked_at=excluded.chunked_at, child_count=excluded.child_count, batch_count=excluded.batch_count, call_count=excluded.call_count,total_tokens=excluded.total_tokens,duration_ms=excluded.duration_ms
mapper.select: SELECT id, content FROM document_chunk WHERE document_id=#{id} AND document_version=#{version} AND NOT deleted AND chunk_type='CHILD' ORDER BY chunk_index, id

SELECT count(*) FROM document_chunk c JOIN document_chunk p ON p.id=c.parent_chunk_id AND p.chunk_type='PARENT' AND NOT p.deleted WHERE c.document_id=#{id} AND c.document_version=#{version} AND NOT c.deleted AND c.chunk_type='CHILD' AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding_model=#{model} AND c.embedding_dimensions=#{dimensions} AND c.embedding_content_hash=encode(sha256(convert_to(c.content,'UTF8')),'hex')
